about: Example questions outside Hank's field (addendum N2 row 2; spec 3.3): a question whose similarity to one of these reaches T_OFF while the search confidence stays under T_HIT gets the farmer reply. Similarity: 3-gram Dice (text.grams, stop words left out) always, the embedding cosine (calibrated like the dense channel) when the vectors are there, the larger one counts. Topics a farmer in a grow box does not answer: weather, sports, politics, code, cooking, homework, travel, money, jokes, general knowledge, films and music, translation, writing, history, games, cars, phones, shopping, people, time. No growing question belongs here; test_offtopic_examples_never_hit_the_cards checks it against the cards.
